<title level="1" pfs="Standard">[Inkdrop](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2761)</title>

<row gap="medium">

<column gap="medium" flex="1 1 400px">

Not all handcrafts are intended for war. The inkdrop is an infiltrator used by spellcasters to learn secrets or alter documents. Embodied in a single fist-sized drop of ink, the inkdrop can glide across a page, changing characters or removing them altogether, with devastating consequences for statecraft.

<column gap="tiny">
**[Recall Knowledge - Construct](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**
([Arcana](/Skills.aspx?ID=2), [Crafting](/Skills.aspx?ID=4)): DC 13

**[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 11

**[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 8
</column>

</column>

<column gap="medium">

</column>

</row>

<title level="2" right="Creature -1">[Inkdrop](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2761)</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Tiny" />
<trait label="Construct" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=35" />
<trait label="Mindless" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=108" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Tian Xia World Guide](/Sources.aspx?ID=223) pg. 278

**Perception** +6; [darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=12)

**Languages**

**Skills**
[Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) +2, [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) +3

<row gap="medium">
**Str** +0

**Dex** -3

**Con** +2

**Int** -5

**Wis** +0

**Cha** -5
</row>

**Perfect Memory** An inkdrop remembers the exact pattern of any ink it moves over physically.

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

<row gap="medium">
**AC** 7 

**Fort** +2 

**Ref** +6 

**Will** +5 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**HP** 15

</row>

**Immunities**
critical hits, mental, precision, spirit, unconscious, vitality, void

**Weaknesses**
cold 5, fire 5

**Blotting** While a creature has the inkdrop [grabbed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=77) or [pinned](/Conditions.aspx?ID=54), it can destroy the inkdrop by smudging the inkdrop out with an Interact action.

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

**Speed** 10 feet, climb 10 feet

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
pseudopod +6,
**Damage** 1d4 bludgeoning plus blinding ink

**Blinding Ink**   A creature critically struck by the inkdrop's pseudopod is blinded by the ink until it clears its eyes using an Interact action.

**Ink Blot** <actions string="Single Action" />  The inkdrop leaves a pattern it remembers over a square foot of surface. If there's existing non-magical ink on the surface, the inkdrop erases the non- magical ink.

</column>
